# fzstd

Unmodified TypeScript source and MIT license from 101arrowz/fzstd at
4527daeb1fd8e5c3cff89262fc0d779593e5f2fd (package version 0.1.1).

index.mjs is generated by Node 24's node:module stripTypeScriptTypes in strip
mode. Only type syntax is removed; the decompression implementation is upstream.
The source is retained so CI can reproduce and compare the generated module.
The package reader checks input/output bounds, ZIP CRC and Zstandard framing
before handing bytes to the loader. This code does not execute a mod.
